# Derived SI intervals for finite capture and two-cohort collision sources

These are derived finite-calculation tables for [Theorems I.13u and I.13v](../../../appendices/appendix_i_scaled_gravity.md). Their fixed SI input assignments, equations, physical domains and complete proofs remain in the native theorems. A decimal endpoint with its printed power of ten denotes that exact rational number. Quantity labels and units use the conventions of the owning theorem.

<a id="capture-si"></a>
